h1: Wix App Market listing that site owners understand
overview: Site owners scan the App Market quickly, so your listing has to say what the app does in one sentence. We write app name options, a tagline, the description and a benefit list, plus the images that show the app in action. We follow Wix's listing guidelines: no ranking promises, no incentivized reviews and no claims you cannot back up. You get text and images ready to enter in the Dev Center.

faq: Will a new listing improve my App Market rank?
We cannot promise rankings, because Wix weighs many things we do not control. We write clear, honest text and strong images, which help site owners understand the app and decide to install it.
Can you write reviews for my listing?
No. We do not write, buy or swap reviews, and doing so breaks Wix's rules. Reviews must come from real site owners who used your app.
What do you need from me?
A short description of what the app does, who it is for, your plans and a few screens or a test link. We write the rest and send it for your approval.
